text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer… It's you. Perfect timing…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: How about some hot-off-the-press divination, ready to go? I spent my whole day off thinking it up. I didn't get a wink of sleep!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: First, you make a peace sign like this, okay? And then you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Matikanefukukitaru hasn't rested at all…
